portal.title: Hefty Raccoon Games
portal.description: The official arcade and game portal for Hefty Raccoon. Play cutting-edge web games, prototypes, and microgames directly in your browser with zero install.

games.title: Abyssal Vault 2D: Sunken Treasure
games.subtitle: Retro Deep-Sea Expedition & Math Cipher Challenge
games.tagline: Classic 2D submarine arcade expedition with procedural ocean depths
games.description: A classic 2D submarine expedition game featuring custom canvas particle systems, procedural sonar audio, depth mine navigation, math cipher puzzle solving, and deep-sea salvage.
games.author: Josh Lyons
features: Lightweight 2D Canvas engine with pixel-perfect submarine physics
Deep sea minefield dodging and torpedo defense

games.title: Abyssal Vault 3D: Deep Sea Expedition
games.subtitle: Realistic 3D Oceanic Submarine Trench Exploration & Math Salvage
games.tagline: Dive 2,260m deep, salvage historical shipwrecks, and escape the Leviathan
games.description: An immersive realistic 3D reproduction of Abyssal Vault using Three.js WebGL and Web Audio API. Pilot a high-tech exploration submarine diving through 3 distinct oceanic depth zones, salvaging sunken pirate galleons, the Titanic, and B-17 bombers, deciphering ancient mechanical cipher vaults, and surviving the Leviathan ascent.
games.controls: Keyboard (W/A/S/D, Arrows, Space, Shift, C for cockpit view) & Mouse/Touch
games.author: Josh Lyons
features: Full 3D WebGL ocean trenches with volumetric caustics, marine snow, and hydrothermal vents
Articulated PBR submarine model with dual cockpit / chase cameras
Historical 3D shipwrecks: The Black Barnacle, R.M.S. Titanic, and B-17 Flying Fortress
3D Interactive mechanical cipher vaults and Leviathan ascent sequence

games.title: Benevolink™: Actual Individual
games.subtitle: Where artificial hyper-intelligence meets actual underpaid individuals
games.description: A satirical WarioWare-style microgame collection built with pure modern ES Modules, HTML5 Canvas, CSS3, and the Web Audio API. Benevolink operates a planetary AI that claims 99.9% autonomy, but panics when it encounters everyday edge cases (ducks, holey socks, CAPTCHAs, smoking servers). Outsmart AI chaos with 2-5 second split-second micro-challenges, climb corporate ladder ranks, or get Promoted to Customer!
games.controls: Keyboard (A/D, Arrows, 1-9, Enter, Space) or Touch/Mouse
games.author: Josh Lyons
features: 8 Distinct Satirical Microgames (Autonomous Car, Sock Sorter, Titanic Cruise, Mars Rover, Captcha Overlord, etc.)
Procedural Synthesized Web Audio Engine with dynamic BGM tempo ramping
SpeechSynthesis Voice Narration and responsive PIP strike system
Dedicated Training / HR Practice Room simulator
